main_text.l: xonum in unum Angliæ Impe-rium coaluerunt.
A.C. 800. Rex West-Saxonum Ebertus primus factus fuit perpetuus Monarcha septem Regnorum: Ac abrogato Saxonum nomine universam gentem appellare voluit Anglos, & regnum Angliæ.

A.C. 1013[?]. Sveno Rex Danorum Angliam expugnavit. Ei successit filius Canutus M.alio nomine dictus Lamprecht. Permansit Anglia in potestate Danorum 26 annos usque ad 1042, quo omnes per Angliam Dani, conspiratione incolarum, unā die trucidati fuere, & regnum restitutum Eduardo Confessori legitimo regni hæredi.

page.notes: The left margin note is printed in a smaller, partly italic type over several short lines with a hyphen "an-nis"; it is transcribed as one note. The year "1013" is printed with a figure resembling a yogh and is uncertain. The page number "98" and the catchword "Pe-" are read from the scan. The reading of "M." after "Canutus" is uncertain. The running head is set in small capitals and is copied as "Regna Britanniæ."
